main.description: Resign the authenticated account's own moderator role in a community this instance hosts: the instance deletes the account's role record from the community's repo and drops the role from its index before responding. The owner cannot resign; ownership must be transferred first. The actor is the authenticated account, never a request field.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; sign in before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a moderator of the community, or the community is not hosted here or is removed; do not retry.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete or malformed: community is not a DID, expectedVersion is negative or idempotencyKey is empty or too long; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is not the community's current roster version, or the indexed roster is behind the community's repo; refetch getCommunityState for the community before retrying.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: OwnerMustTransfer
errors.description: The caller is the community's owner, who cannot resign; transfer ownership first.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.description: The caller holds no moderator role in the community, or its role record is already gone from the community's repo.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service or the community's repo is temporarily unavailable; retry later with the same idempotency key.

input.description: Request to resign the caller's moderator role

expectedVersion.description: The community's roster version (getCommunityState with the community DID as subject) the caller expects

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes a retry of the same request return its first result; scoped to the caller and the community

output.description: The roster change, applied before the response returns

subject.description: DID of the account whose moderator role was removed

version.description: The community's roster version after the change
